name: Gen-4.5 / Runway Dev
novel_abilities: Prompt or first-frame generation on separate API operations
Professional delivery formats with model-specific HDR controls
notes: Model launch was 2025-12-01; Runway API availability was 2026-02-10, not a new model release.

Durations are whole seconds. Text mode supports 1280:720 and 720:1280; image mode adds 1104:832, 960:960, 832:1104 and 1584:672. Validate dimensions on the actual operation; the router represents only the nominal 720p tier.
The inspected image contract accepts position=first only. Do not infer first/last control from unrelated Runway-hosted models.
Native generated audio and selectable API frame rate remain unverified. The web UI's 24/25fps control is not imported into this API record.
HDR output and EXR export do not establish exr-hdr-roundtrip support. Check provider access and any format surcharge.

name: Aleph 2.0 / Runway Dev
novel_abilities: Edits source clips with up to five timed keyframes
Supports timed edit windows and aspect-ratio expansion
notes: This records Runway API availability, not a claimed underlying model launch date.
Requires one source video of 2–30 seconds. Router duration must be interpreted as the source/edit length at preflight; no separate output-duration parameter is established.
reference_images counts optional timed guidance keyframes on this record, not loose reference images; the timestamps and all-or-none edit-window rule require provider-schema validation.
targetAspectRatio performs source-canvas expansion. Do not infer temporal extension, prompt-only creation or free-form mask support.
Native HDR is not an Aleph output option in the inspected contract: use a separate Ruby conversion. ProRes 4444 alpha is fully opaque.
gen4_aleph was removed on 2026-07-30. Use aleph2; API resolution and frame-rate limits remain unrecorded rather than inheriting web-UI input limits.
